The rendered list on the homepage and /calendar is the enumerator; both carry identical 17-row lists on 2026-09-10 (Aug 2, 2026 → Jan 2, 2027). coverage.basis: Enumerator = /calendar (static curl, Chrome UA): 17 event-item cards, each with a JSON-LD Event block and a visible "Mon D, YYYY H:MM AM/PM" line; the homepage (the configured URL) renders the identical 17 as a link list plus the first 6 as cards — 17/17 titles, dates and tixr URLs agree between the two pages. 1 of the 17 is past (Outwig, Outslay, Outdrag — Aug 2, 2026, still the first card): counted here, not enumerated → 16 published upcoming events (Sep 10, 2026 – Jan 2, 2027), all singles with explicit year; no series is stated on either listing page. Second door = sitemap.xml (479 URLs): its 17 /shows slugs are a different, abandoned CMS collection — 7 return a contentless template shell, 10 return 404; only 6 slugs match a current calendar title (outwig, tkvr-cucci, tkvr-nolid, tkvr-dj-girlfriends, tkvr-flittie, horse-meat-disco-1-02-27; bronze-babez-show matches but 404s), 10 calendar events have no /shows slug (PACK, Massive Friday Shea Coulee, Dungeon and Drag Queens, Bearracuda | Seattle, Black Swan, Haruka, Press Play, Twink Bash, PERVERT MX, Looking), and 10 /shows slugs are past-only or never-listed (bearracuda glow party, bottom-forty hard labor day, butt-blast, get-2-soaked-babe-night, hostile-noise, it-girl, massive-friday-c-powers-atl, pack-party, tkvr-august-v-m, treasure-trail-seattle). Delta explained: the calendar collection (which drives both listing pages) is maintained; the /shows collection is not, and the sitemap is generated from CMS items regardless. Third check = scraper page cache of /calendar from 2026-09-07 (16 rows): minus Hard Labor Day (Sep 6, since removed), plus Black Swan and Press Play (since added) = today's 17, so the list churns by hand within days. Tixr (17 event pages + group page) is DataDome-blocked for curl and headless Chrome, so end times come from 7 flyers and endDate from JSON-LD; nothing on Tixr can add or remove an event from the venue's own list.
knownGaps: Tixr event pages (the only per-event pages the site links to) are DataDome-blocked (403 for curl, headless Chrome, and the /api path), so descriptions, door times and ticket tiers beyond the JSON-LD single price are not captured; endTime is asserted only where a flyer states it (7 of 16).
JSON-LD startDate/endDate are date-only ("Sep 10, 2026"); times come from the visible "H:MM PM" line. endDate is copied from JSON-LD as published (next-day for late shows, same-day for early ones).
